$description: Loci tokens, extracted from Claude Design project 'Pairing Lab', direction 4a (Round 4) and its Gallery screens. Source of truth for src/tokens.css. Ratios are WCAG contrast against the named background.

stone.$description: ser: the place, the granite. These never change.

ground.$description: Darkest ground. Splash, cards, Material surface (dark).

brand.$description: The constant. App background (dark). Material primary.

body.$description: Body and place names. 11.56 on brand.

caption.$description: Mono captions, time, data. 6.72 on brand.

light.$description: estar: the moment. Light that passes over the stone.

cold.$description: Cold light. The 'o', outlines. Material secondary. 7.92 on brand.

warm.$description: Warm light. The estar word. Material tertiary. 7.16 on brand.

warm-on-paper.$description: Warm light for the light theme. 4.83 on paper.

live.$description: Mint. Live and recording only: capture button and record state. 9.25 on brand.

afterglow.$description: Color = age of a capture. Warm when new, cools to blue over a month.

card-on-texture.$description: Gallery row over the granite texture (stone.ground at 72%).

screen-on-texture.$description: Full screen over the granite texture (stone.ground at 80%, so the texture shows at 20%). Over the image's lightest pixel (#FFFFFF) it gives #3C484D: Label 4.87, Note 6.35, live button 6.70. The 72% card overlay is not enough here: Label 3.64 fails.

space.$description: Base unit 4px (0.25rem). Every step is a whole number of base units. Components use the role names only.

page-inset.$description: 16px. Gap between the screen edge and content.

stack-tight.$description: 8px. Between things that belong together, e.g. a name and its sample.

inline.$description: 8px. Between things side by side, e.g. an icon and its text.

size.$description: Fixed sizes for controls. Same 4px base unit as spacing.

record-button.$description: 64px = 16 x 4. The capture button. Well above the 44px minimum touch target.

icon.$description: 24px = 6 x 4. Icons, e.g. the record dot.

focus-ring.$description: 2px. Outline width when a control has keyboard focus.

opacity.$description: How see-through a control gets in a state.

pressed.$description: While a finger is on it. A small dip: it answers the touch.

disabled.$description: Cannot be used right now. Clearly faded.

serif.$description: ser voice. Upright for place, italic for the moment.

display.$description: Splash and large moments only. Light 300 is allowed only at 32px and up.

moment.$description: The mood line. Colored by afterglow age. Design shows 17 to 19px.
